nodes.label: Statement 14: VMAT2 Inhibitor for Moderate-Severe Tardive Dyskinesia
nodes.rationale: VMAT2 inhibitors significantly reduce tardive motor signs; benefits far outweigh sedation and mood-related risks in moderate to severe or disabling disease.

nodes.label: Reversible VMAT2 Inhibitor (Valbenazine, Deutetrabenazine, Tetrabenazine)
nodes.rationale: Deutetrabenazine or valbenazine preferred over tetrabenazine for evidence base and tolerability; choose by hepatic, renal, CYP2D6/CYP3A4, and QTc considerations.

nodes.label: Tardive Dyskinesia Assessment with AIMS or DISCUS
nodes.rationale: Persistent choreoathetoid movements after sustained exposure need regular structured exams; no single score threshold mandates treatment, and withdrawal-emergent versus spontaneous dyskinesia must be excluded.
